188014416.reason: Returns immediately when a partial subset is valid, so it never explores valid supersets of that subset. For 4 15 60 10 / 10 20 30 25 it counts 4 instead of all 6 valid subsets.

193158167.reason: Prunes a partial subset when its sum is below l or its spread is below x, even though adding later problems can satisfy both lower bounds. The initial empty subset is pruned, so 3 5 6 1 / 1 2 3 returns 0 instead of 2.

197643532.reason: Uses abs(last-first) for each combination rather than max-min, without sorting the input. Valid subsets with extrema in interior positions are discarded; on the recorded unsorted n=10 case it returns 475 instead of 914.

208069928.reason: Enumerates n-length ordered tuples with repetition rather than subsets of distinct problems, and applies strict inequalities to all three inclusive bounds. On 3 5 6 1 / 1 2 3 its strict sum test excludes both valid boundary-sum subsets and returns 0 instead of 2.

208074946.reason: Subtracts 1 from both inclusive sum bounds even though they are numerical constraints, not indices. On 4 40 50 10 / 10 20 30 25 it accepts sums 39..49 instead of 40..50 and returns 1 instead of 2.
